items.mainDefect: Direct membership deletion bypasses primary-group cleanup, leaving primary_group_id pointing to the removed group.

secondary.defect: Direct deletion skips callbacks and deletion tracking expected by Group.save.
The subsequent group.save is redundant because the deletion has already executed.

items.mainDefect: PATCH requests with membership changes now return success without applying those changes.

secondary.defect: PATCH requests targeting automatic groups no longer receive the previous 403 rejection.
